executivePulse.interpretation: The situation in memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM/RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the tightest areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-19 reviewed eight relevant current reports; it does not indicate any confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market only with a lag. For buyers, securing supply, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
